text: Really a great app! Very useful to keep track of your products and the analysis of ingredients is really well done, without any fearmongering. The community feature is also great, it's nice to chat with other people and ask any questions we have
author: Marie Gauthier
developer_reply: Thank you, Marie, happy you enjoy the app! It is extremely important for us to make sure there's no fearmongering in the app, so glad you appreciated it. We also highlight ingredient functions that specifically target each person's selected skin concerns. Much more cool features to come as we continuously work on the app! :)

text: Great! Just wish we could have a widget for the routines.
